newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off, AMS seen easing. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off, AMS seen easing. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]

text.p: 1330 GMT - Austrian ATX blue chip index closed softer on Monday (corrects day) in line with international markets. Traders see more pressure for AMS ahead of its expected release of first quarter figures on Tuesday.
* ATX index down 3.64 points or 0.3 percent at 1,202.57
* Six ATX shares up, 14 down, one unchanged
* Top gainer highgrade steelmaker Boehler up 1.13 percent at 892 ATS
* Top loser microchip maker AMS, down 5.64 percent at 920 ATS
* May ATX futures down 4.7 points at 1,191.5 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
